definitions.explanation: Vegetables that are in season during summer, such as tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplants, and bell peppers.

examples.japanese: {夏野菜|なつやさい}がおいしい{季節|きせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's the season when summer vegetables are delicious.

examples.japanese: {夏野菜|なつやさい}をたっぷり{使|つか}ったカレーを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a curry using lots of summer vegetables.

examples.japanese: {畑|はたけ}で{育|そだ}てた{夏野菜|なつやさい}を{近所|きんじょ}の{人|ひと}にもおすそ{分|わ}けした。
examples.english: I shared some of the summer vegetables I grew in my garden with my neighbors.

notes: Typical summer vegetables in Japan include トマト (tomato), きゅうり (cucumber), なす (eggplant), ピーマン (bell pepper), とうもろこし (corn), オクラ (okra), and ゴーヤ (bitter melon). Common in food writing and seasonal cooking. {夏野菜|なつやさい}カレー (summer vegetable curry) is a popular dish. Similar seasonal terms: {冬野菜|ふゆやさい} (winter vegetables), {春野菜|はるやさい} (spring vegetables).
